notes: This is the Thunderbolt 3 version of Apollo Twin X (Mac/Windows), distinct from the "Apollo Twin X USB" variant (Windows-only, USB-C/USB 3.0, different power spec). Data pulled directly from the official UA "Apollo Twin X Hardware Manual" (Manual Version 210429), the manufacturer's authoritative source. Mic/Line Combo Inputs 1 & 2 are XLR female (pin 2 positive) combo jacks that also accept 1/4" TRS line-level plugs — modeled as xlr3 primary with trs-6.35 accepted. The front-panel Hi-Z instrument input is a separate physical 1/4" TS jack that internally overrides channel 1's mic/line input when a plug is inserted (not a combo jack on the same physical connector). Rear-panel 1/4" jacks (line outs, monitor outs) accept both TS unbalanced and TRS balanced plugs per the manual, and are wired balanced TRS female. The Thunderbolt 3 port is a USB-C-shaped connector (confirmed by hardware block diagram labeling it "TYPE-C"); grade set to usb-40g reflecting Thunderbolt 3's 40 Gbps signaling rate (thunderbolt is not in the HDMI/DP/SDI/RJ45 graded families but is included in the USB-family grade scale per the instructions). Power is via external 12VDC power brick (Level VI compliant AC-to-DC supply) connecting to the unit via a locking 2.1mm x 5.5mm center-positive DC barrel jack — the brick itself has an IEC C8/C7 AC inlet, but the device's own physical port is the DC barrel input. Optical input is a single TOSLINK jack, software-selectable between ADAT (up to 8ch) or S/PDIF (2ch) — not simultaneous, so listed as one bidirectional-protocol input port. Desktop unit, not rack-mountable (no rackUnits set).
